signals.summary: Glean joined OpenAI's new B2B marketplace as a launch partner. Eligible enterprise customers can use part of their OpenAI commitment on Glean.

At Glean GO 2026, Glean reportedly launched a new class of proactive agents, starting with an OnCall Assistant, along with an AI desktop workspace. This comes from a LinkedIn recap, not a Glean primary source. The recap is dated about 3 weeks before today, and I can't pin down the exact date.
Glean has a Team Chat feature that puts teams and AI in one shared chat and dashboard. A product demo video was posted within the last week.

answer.notes: The searches found no new funding round in the last 90 days. The latest confirmed round in the results is the $150M Series F from June 2025 at a $7.2B valuation, led by Wellington Management. Tracxn lists $765M raised in total. That round falls outside the 90-day window, so it isn't listed as a signal. The searches found nothing on leadership changes, acquisitions, layoffs, earnings or hiring. A search for those returned irrelevant results, and one later search failed. The GO 2026 and Team Chat items rest on secondary sources, so check Glean's own announcements before citing specifics. A good opening angle is the OpenAI marketplace partnership and the shift toward agents.
